title: phacelia cumingii var. litoralis
intro: Phacelia cumingii var. litoralis, commonly known as a coastal plant species, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, as well as its ability to aid in wound healing and antimicrobial actions. The therapeutic actions of Phacelia cumingii var. litoralis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, and may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. However, more research is needed to fully understand its effects and to confirm its safety for human use.
